name: DFW Cubing Spring 2026
information:
## Southern Cubing welcomes you to Arlington, Texas for DFW Cubing Spring 2026! This competition will feature the WCA's new Head-to-Head format in FOUR different events! Check out the [Head-to-Head tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWCubingSpring2026#69237-head-to-head) for additional information.

***Please note that no outside food/drink will be permitted in the venue, however it is permitted in the foyer outside the expo hall.***

This competition is supported by Southern Cubing LLC. To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
